messages.body_plain:
Sir,

I am trying to execute a program using mlp function and parallelizing it using pbdMPI functions. It is executing for 200 rows properly, but if I am trying to use that for more than 200 rows it is showing the error like this
"Error in myFunc[[1]](x, ...) :
  number of input data columns 214 does not match number of input neurons 1
Calls: obj_fun ... predict -> predict.rsnns -> <Anonymous> -> <Anonymous>
Execution halted".

I will be happy if you resolve this issue.

Thanks & Regards,
T. Sai Sujana.

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

thanks for sending me the data file. The problem is that if you call the
predict function with a vector, it converts it to a matrix with one row,
where what you want is a matrix with one column. I have adapted RSNNS to
convert to 1 column iff the network has 1 input, to 1 row otherwise.

You can get an updated version from github with

library(devtools)
install_github("cbergmeir/RSNNS/RSNNS")

However, a very easy workaround for you should be to make sure to pass a
matrix, i.e., where you have:

x1=new_data[,1:(ncol(new_data)-1)]

you want to have:

x1=new_data[,1:(ncol(new_data)-1), drop=FALSE]

so that x1 stays a matrix.

Regards,
Christoph
